summary: Multi-Agent Self-RAG: Retrieval Agent > Evaluation Agent > Reasoning Agent > Revision Agent. Agents auto-retrieve knowledge before analysis, accuracy improved from 58% to 89%.

title: Tencent WeKnora: Open source knowledge platform - docs to RAG + autonomous reasoning agent
summary: WeKnora turns raw documents into queryable RAG, autonomous reasoning agent, and self-maintaining Wiki. ReAct agent orchestrates RAG + MCP tools + web search for multi-step reasoning.

detail.query: knowledge base integration with expert system

title: Hermes Agent: Knowledgebase RAG with auto_retrieve context injection
summary: Hermes Agent auto_retrieve mechanism: auto-inject relevant knowledge chunks into agent context. Hybrid search (sqlite-vec + FTS5). Multi-agent pipeline integration.

detail.query: agent auto-retrieve knowledge base before analysis

title: DACS: Dynamic Attentional Context Scoping - agent-triggered focus sessions
summary: DACS: Registry mode (200 tokens/agent summary) vs Focus mode (full context for one agent, compress others). Steering accuracy 90-98.4% vs 21-60% flat baseline. Context efficiency ratio 3.53x.

title: PSMAS: Phase-Scheduled Multi-Agent Systems for token-efficient coordination
summary: Global sweep signal activates agents within angular window. Idle agents receive compressed summaries (12% of full length). Mean token reduction 27.3%, performance drop only 2.1pp. Scheduling alone contributes 18-20pp reduction.

title: Context Engineering Guide: sub-agent isolation saves 65% token
summary: Sub-agent isolation: 100-page PDF from 150K to 52K tokens (65% reduction). Sub-agents return ~1-2K condensed summary. Standardized agent contracts (structured output schemas).

title: late-cli: Ephemeral agent architecture - zero token bloat
summary: Ephemeral agent architecture: lean orchestrator delegates to isolated sub-agents, history destroyed on completion. Core prompt ~1000 tokens vs industry 10k+. Never pollutes orchestrator context.

title: TokenDance: Collective KV cache sharing for multi-agent serving
summary: Exploits All-Gather pattern KV cache redundancy: round-aware prompt + collective KV reuse + diff-based storage. 17.5x per-agent KV cache reduction, 2.7x more concurrent agents.

title: Cheetah.ai: Shared context bridge - workflow DAG pre-warms KV cache
summary: Control plane reads workflow DAG, pre-warms next agent KV cache before current agent finishes. Restructures prompts to [SYS]+[DOC]+[TASK] for prefix cache hits. Subsequent agents TTFT < 0.5s.

title: RAG Pipeline Security Best Practices 2026: whitelist, admission checks, pre-filtering
summary: Complete RAG security pipeline: source vetting (authenticated whitelist repos) > adversarial scan > metadata tagging (PHI/PII redaction before embedding) > retrieval-time metadata filtering. Pre-filter blocks unauthorized data before indexing.

title: Content Filtering and Trust Tier Architecture for prompt injection defense
summary: Dual-layer defense: input normalization (null byte/control char/path traversal removal) + output structural enrichment (trust tier + source agent metadata). Agent trust tier model Tier 0-3.

title: Nomad: Autonomous Exploration and Discovery system
summary: Nomad builds Exploration Map over domain. Explorer agent uses doc/web search/db tools to investigate hypotheses. Independent verifier checks findings. Focus on which questions are worth asking.

title: Caesar Framework: Graph-based discovery - beyond retrieval to open exploration
summary: Two-phase design: deep graph web exploration + adversarial refinement. Builds dynamic knowledge graph linking concepts/sources/insights. Outperforms SOTA on novelty/usefulness/surprising connections.

title: SafeHarness: Lifecycle-integrated security architecture - 4 defense layers
summary: L1 INFORM (adversarial filtering/pattern matching) > L2 VERIFY (3-tier causal verification) > L3 CONSTRAIN (capability token action control) > L4 CORRECT (safe rollback + adaptive degradation). UBR -38%, ASR -42%.

title: Traefik Multi-Vendor AI Safety Pipeline: 4-layer parallel guard architecture
summary: 4 parallel guards: Regex (ms) > Content (PII) > LLM Guard (topic/safety/jailbreak) > LLM Guard (hallucination/RAG). Circuit breaker: any block cancels all, returns structured JSON refusal.

title: AIDDM: AI Agent Defense in Depth - 4 layers for production
summary: L1 Edge/Network > L2 Input/Prompt validation > L3 Reasoning/Runtime (tool whitelist/schema/sandbox/HITL) > L4 Output (redaction/hallucination detection/streaming cut). Maps to 6 canonical attack types.

title: OmniMem: Five-layer hybrid memory - Perception > Working > Structured > Deep > Internalized
summary: Five layers: L0 Perception > L1 Working > L2 Structured > L3 Deep > L4 Internalized. Governance engine (conflict/decay/forgetting/privacy/traceability). Hybrid retrieval: vector + BM25 + RRF + KG.

title: Dynamic Memory Tiering: Hot/Warm/Cold based on access frequency
summary: HOT (always loaded ~2k tokens) / WARM (semantic search via LanceDB) / COLD (archived deep search). Session-end compaction: done tasks > COLD, inactive prefs > WARM, active blockers > HOT.

title: mneme: 3-layer memory - persistent facts + cross-session tasks + ephemeral execution
summary: Ledger (long-term verified facts, human approval to modify) / Beads (mid-term cross-session task state) / OpenCode (short-term execution). Survives context compaction without vector memory.

detail.query: short term long term memory agent

title: EvoSkill: Automated skill discovery for multi-agent systems - evolutionary loop
summary: Evolution loop: Base > Proposer (analyze failures) > Generator (write skills/prompts) > Evaluator (score on validation set) > Frontier (keep top-N). Agent configs as versioned programs with git branches.

title: AutoSkill: Experience-driven lifelong learning via skill self-evolution
summary: Extract skills from real dialogues/agent traces, continuously evolve via merge+version updates (v0.1.0 > v0.1.1). SkillEvo: replay > evaluate > mutate > promote.

title: Agent Taxonomy: Skills as genes - Lamarckian evolution + horizontal gene transfer
summary: Agent config as GENOME.md organism: Lamarckian evolution (acquired traits inherited) + horizontal gene transfer (shared skills) + human selection. SKILL.md files portable/versionable/active/silent/transferable.

title: AVES: LLM multi-agent trading with Kelly Criterion + volatility targeting
summary: LLM multi-agent ensemble + dynamic regime adaptation. Continuous position sizing: Kelly Criterion + volatility targeting. Multi-timeframe (1m-1d). Portfolio risk: correlation/VaR/drawdown controls.

title: kalshi-trading-bot-cli: 5-gate risk engine + Kelly sizing
summary: Edge vs live orderbook > half-Kelly > 5-gate risk filter. Kelly gated by liquidity/correlation/concentration/drawdown checks. Configurable kelly_multiplier/max_drawdown/max_positions.

title: market-edge: LLM prediction market agent - probability pipeline + rules engine
summary: 4-pass LLM probability pipeline > Kelly sizing. Three-loop agent: Research (async) > Strategy (daily) > Tactical (15min). Rule-driven: rules auto-deploy from strategy to execution layer, decoupled.

title: DREAM: Dynamic Retention Episodic Memory with tiered storage + adaptive TTL
summary: Active (frequent reuse > long TTL) / Dormant (cold storage not deletion) tiers. O(1) cost, self-pruning TTL based on actual usage. Empirical O(1) vs O(n^2) for transformers.

title: agent-learn: Recursive learning framework - Trace > Analyze > Validate > Inject cycle
summary: Trace > Analyze > Validate > Inject cycle. A/B testing (5%+ improvement, zero regression), hybrid search (FTS5+embeddings), effectiveness tracking, auto-deprecation. Output is readable text (skills/checklists/rules).
